hints.L0: Think about how to split a 32-bit addition into two 16-bit additions with carry propagation.
hints.L3: Connect the low 16 bits of a and b to the first add16 with carry-in 0; feed its carry-out into the second add16's carry-in along with the high 16 bits of a and b; combine the two 16-bit sums into the 32-bit output.

common_mistakes: Forgetting to set the low adder's carry-in to 0.
Swapping the high and low halves when concatenating the sum.
Using the final carry-out as part of the sum.
Not connecting the carry-out of the low adder to the carry-in of the high adder.
top: module top_module(input [31:0] a, input [31:0] b, output [31:0] sum)
